notes.summary: Direction questions trace a person's walk and ask for the final direction or the shortest distance from the start. Draw the path as you read. Usually 1 question in Tier 1 and Tier 2.

concepts.title: The compass
concepts.body: North is up, South down, East right, West left. NE, NW, SE, SW lie between them. A right turn = 90° clockwise; a left turn = 90° anticlockwise.

concepts.title: Shortest distance
concepts.body: Add all East–West moves and all North–South moves separately. The shortest distance is √(x² + y²) (Pythagoras). Learn the triples 3-4-5, 5-12-13, 8-15-17, 6-8-10.

concepts.title: Shadows
concepts.body: The sun rises in the East. In the morning shadows fall to the West; in the evening they fall to the East. At noon there is almost no shadow.

varieties.name: Final facing direction
varieties.how: Track only the turns: right = +90° clockwise, left = −90°.

example.q: Facing North, a man turns right, then right again. Where does he face?

varieties.name: Distance and direction from start
varieties.how: Draw the path, find net x and net y, then use Pythagoras.

example.q: Walk 3 km North, then 4 km East. Distance from start?

varieties.name: Shadow based
varieties.how: Morning sun in the East → shadow to the West. Evening → shadow to the East.

example.q: In the morning, Ravi's shadow falls to his left. Which way is he facing?
steps: If West is on his left, he faces North.

tips: Always draw a rough sketch, even for easy questions.
Turning "left" depends on the way the person is facing, not on your page.
For direction of B from A, place yourself at A and look at B.
traps: Direction of A from B is the opposite of the direction of B from A.
Do not add all distances; find the straight-line distance.

questions.q: Ravi is facing North. He turns 90° clockwise and then 180° anticlockwise. Which direction is he facing now?
A man walks 3 km towards North and then 4 km towards East. How far is he from his starting point?
questions.solution:
The two moves are at right angles.
Distance = √(3² + 4²) = √25 = 5 km.

questions.q: Sita walks 10 m towards South. She turns left and walks 6 m, then turns left and walks 18 m, and then turns right and walks 9 m. How far and in which direction is she from her starting point?
questions.solution:
South 10 m: (0, −10).
Facing South, left = East: 6 m → (6, −10).
Facing East, left = North: 18 m → (6, 8).
Facing North, right = East: 9 m → (15, 8).
Distance = √(15² + 8²) = √289 = 17 m, towards North-East.

questions.q: Study the figure. A person walks from P to Q (5 km East) and then from Q to R (12 km North). What is the shortest distance between P and R, and in which direction is R from P?
questions.solution:
Net movement: 5 km East and 12 km North.
PR = √(5² + 12²) = √169 = 13 km.
R is up and to the right of P, so R is North-East of P.

questions.q: One morning after sunrise, Rahul was standing facing a pole. The shadow of the pole fell exactly to his right. Which direction was Rahul facing?
questions.solution:
In the morning the sun is in the East, so shadows fall towards the West.
The shadow is on Rahul's right, so his right side is West.
A person whose right is West is facing South.

questions.q: Point A is 8 m West of point B. Point C is 12 m North of B. Point D is 8 m East of C. What is the distance between A and D, and in which direction is D from A?
questions.solution:
Take B = (0, 0). Then A = (−8, 0), C = (0, 12), D = (8, 12).
From A to D: 16 m East and 12 m North.
AD = √(16² + 12²) = √400 = 20 m, towards North-East.
